home.badge: Free to try, no account needed
home.headline: Learn the songs you love, one loop at a time.
home.pricing_body: Every practice tool works on every song you have, on the free plan. Plus adds more analyses each month.
home.pricing_title: Free is a real practice app
home.proof_honest_body: Auto-transcription gets most of a song right. The parts it isn't sure about are marked, and one tap fixes them.
home.proof_honest_point_1: Chords and notes it isn't sure about get a dashed outline, and the shakiest get a ?
home.proof_honest_point_2: Tap one to see what else it might be
home.proof_honest_point_3: Fix it once and the fix stays with the song
home.proof_honest_title: Tab that admits when it's unsure
home.proof_isolate_body: Hear just the guitar or bass line, or turn it down and play along with the rest of the band.
home.proof_isolate_point_1: Turn your part up, mute it to play along, or hear the original
home.proof_isolate_point_2: Separate faders for guitar, bass, drums, vocals and keys
home.proof_isolate_point_3: Mute or solo any of them
home.proof_loop_body: Tap the bars you want, loop them and slow them down without changing the pitch. Speed up as it gets clean.
home.proof_loop_point_1: Tap the first and last bar to loop them. The loop snaps to the beat.
home.proof_loop_point_2: Slow down to 50 % and the pitch stays put
home.proof_loop_point_3: Mark the clean passes and see your best speed for each loop
home.stand_beat_body: The count-in and metronome follow the song's actual beat, so they stay with the band when it speeds up or drags.
home.stand_beat_title: A count-in that follows the band
home.stand_intro: Little things that help when both hands are on the instrument.
home.stand_offline_body: Once you've opened a song, it keeps working without a connection.
home.stand_pedal_body: Everything has a keyboard shortcut, and a page-turner pedal can restart the loop for you.
home.stand_progress_body: You see the fastest speed you've played each loop cleanly. No streaks, no guilt trips about missed days.
home.stand_read_body: Say whether the screen is on a desk, a stand or the floor, and the tab gets big enough to read from there.
home.stand_stage_body: A dark score with soft ink for late-night practice. Nothing flashes bright.
home.step_1: Upload a file, record yourself or paste a link.
home.step_2: Splitune isolates it and works out the beat, chords and tab.
home.step_3: Tap the bars you're learning, loop them and slow them down.
home.step_4: Mark the clean passes and nudge the speed up as it comes together.
home.step_4_title: Speed up as it gets clean
home.still_caption: The practice screen: bars 5–8 looping at 70 %, with the unsure chord and notes marked.
home.subhead: Bring a song. Splitune isolates your part, shows the chords and tab, and lets you loop and slow down any bar.
how.accuracy_body: Auto-transcription gets most of a song right and marks the bits it's unsure about. You can fix any chord or note in a couple of taps.
how.intro: Four steps turn a song into something you can practise.
how.step_1_body: Upload an audio or video file, record yourself, or paste a link. Songs up to 20 minutes work.
how.step_2_body: Separation models split the song into stems, so you can hear your guitar or bass on its own or play along without it.
how.step_3_body: The beat sets the bar lines, then the chords and your part's notes are worked out and laid out as tab.
how.step_3_title: We find the beat, chords and tab
how.step_4_body: Loop any bars, slow them down without changing the pitch and mark clean passes as you go.
how.title: How it works

legal.privacy.delete_body: Deleting a song removes its files within the hour. Deleting your account (Settings → Privacy) removes everything in it.
legal.privacy.device_body: Display preferences and unfinished uploads are kept in your browser's storage on this device only.
legal.privacy.what_body: Your email address, the songs you import and what Splitune makes from them, and your practice progress.
legal.privacy.where_body: Account data is in a database on Railway; audio and analysis files are in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket. Analysis runs on the owner's computer.
legal.terms.accuracy_body: Stems, chords and tab are made automatically and can contain mistakes. Splitune marks the parts it is unsure about.
legal.terms.billing_body: Plans are simulated in this deployment. No real payments are taken and no card details are ever asked for.
legal.terms.ending_body: You can delete a song or your account at any time. Deleting removes its stems, loops and edits.
legal.terms.service_body: Splitune is a personal practice tool run by one person for themselves and a few friends. It comes as it is, without guarantees of availability.
legal.terms.songs_body: Songs you import stay private to your account. They are used only to make your stems, chords and tab.
